headline: Number of non-financial companies in Portugal rose 52.5% between 2006 and 2025
summary: Banco de Portugal data show the number of non-financial companies in Portugal rose 52.5% between 2006 and 2025. Greater Lisbon now concentrates fewer companies, people and business volume.
why: The count of operating companies is a broad indicator of economic structure and business formation, relevant to assessing the health of a national economy.
